battle.name: 雀鼠谷之戰
battle.brief: 大業十二年（616），甄翟兒聚眾十萬寇太原，命太原留守李淵往討，於雀鼠谷遇敵。賊眾十倍官軍，李淵被圍數匝，世民以精兵突入救出，步兵趕到合擊，大破之。卡面科林斯青銅盔屬公元前六五〇年的希臘，此役無一字記載；但那副只留一線眼縫、逼人靠隊形活命的頭盔，正是數千對十萬亂戰裡最缺的東西。

kit.name: 科林斯青銅盔
kit.history: 全正面開眼的青銅盔。看得見的代價是：戴它的人只能靠隊形活。

countries: 大業十二年（616）冬，雀鼠谷的兩造都不是一支像樣的軍隊。一方是隋朝的河東邊軍與太原留守府：朝廷正月已議定分遣使者十二道發兵討捕盜賊，把平叛拆成十二路分頭進剿，李淵以右驍衛將軍之號領太原留守赴任，身邊只帶虎賁郎將王威、虎牙郎將高君雅兩名副將，兵源兼有府兵、河東邊軍與臨時括來的鄉兵，總數不過數千。另一方是歷山飛部將甄翟兒所率的十萬眾，屬隋末典型的散兵為盜：破郡縣後裹來的鄉民、失散的府兵與亡命徒混成一團，沒有軍籍，沒有甲兵制式，只靠人數與兇悍維持。兩個指揮系統的落差，正是此役勝負的根：一方有留守府的號令、倉儲與騎兵，一方只有跟著首領走的隊形。卡面科林斯青銅盔出自公元前六五〇年的希臘，屬城邦重步兵的裝備，拿它比附兩造倒不必勉強，但它劃出一條門檻：希臘人靠成建制的方陣與盾牆作戰，中原的義軍連這一層都談不上。
countriesEn: In the winter of Daye 12 (616), neither side at Sparrow Valley was a proper army. On one side stood the Sui's Hedong frontier troops together with the office of the Taiyuan garrison. The court had already resolved in the first month to split the suppression of the bandits among envoys dispatched along twelve circuits, and Li Yuan went out as Right Xiaowei General holding the seal of the Taiyuan garrison, with only two deputies, Wang Wei of the Tiger Guard cavalry and Gao Junya of the Tiger Tooth. His men mixed fubing, Hedong border soldiers and hastily conscripted villagers, and numbered only a few thousand. On the other side stood the hundred thousand followers of Zhen Di'er, formerly a subordinate of Li Shanfei, the typical late Sui crowd of routed soldiers turned bandits: villagers swept up after county seats fell, fubing deserters and fugitives all in one body, with no military registers and no standard issue of armour, held together only by numbers and ferocity. The gulf between the two command systems is the root of the result. One side had the garrison's orders, its granaries and its cavalry; the other had nothing but a column of men following its leader. The Corinthian helmet on the card was forged in Greece around 650 BC as the headgear of citizen heavy infantry. It need not be forced into the comparison, but it marks a threshold: Greeks fought in formed phalanxes behind a wall of shields, while the Central Plain insurgents did not have that much.
people: 核心是李淵父子與三名配角。右驍衛將軍、太原留守李淵出身關中太原，其母乃隋文帝獨孤氏之姊，與隋室有姻親；他素為煬帝所忌，被外放太原，名為討賊，實為剝奪兵柄。十八歲的李世民隨父在晉陽，尚無官職，卻已讀兵書、善騎射，此役是他第一次統精兵上陣。副將王威為虎賁郎將、高君雅為虎牙郎將，皆太原留守府心腹；一年之後劉武周攻破晉陽時二人力戰而死，正因為失此城、失此二人，李淵父子才再無退路。反面是歷山飛部將甄翟兒，率眾十萬自歷山壓向太原，先在四月擊殺隋將潘長文，聲勢最盛時仍在谷地被數千官軍打崩。遠處還有在朝中壓下真報的內史侍郎虞世基，以及河北乘勢坐大的竇建德、高士達、張金稱等人。科林斯青銅盔提示了一種看不見全局的處境：希臘將領戴著它只能靠鼓點與口令掌握本部，李淵靠旗鼓號令，世民靠的則是衝出重圍那一瞬自己的判斷。
peopleEn: The figures at the centre are Li Yuan and his sons, plus three supporting players. Right Xiaowei General and Taiyuan garrison commander Li Yuan was a native of Taiyuan in Guanzhong whose mother was a sister of Emperor Wen's empress, so he was bound to the Sui house by marriage. He had long been distrusted by Yang Guang and was posted to Taiyuan, nominally to punish bandits and in truth to strip him of military power. Li Shimin, then eighteen years old, was with his father at Jinyang; he held no office yet, but he had read military books and was a skilled horseman and archer, and this was the first time he led picked troops in the field. His deputies, Wang Wei of the Tiger Guard cavalry and Gao Junya of the Tiger Tooth, were trusted men of the garrison; a year later, when Liu Wuzhou's forces took Jinyang, both died fighting, and precisely because the city and those two men were lost, Li Yuan and Li Shimin had no retreat left. Opposite them was Zhen Di'er, formerly a subordinate of Li Shanfei, who led a hundred thousand men down from Lishan toward Taiyuan and killed the Sui general Pan Changwen in the fourth month at the height of his strength, and was still shattered in the valley by a few thousand government soldiers. In the background sat Yu Shiji, the Palace Secretary who held back true reports, and in the north Ding Jiande, Gao Shida and Zhang Jincheng, who grew strong on the disorder. The Corinthian helmet evokes a condition of blindness: a Greek commander wearing it could hold his own command only by drumbeat and word of mouth. Li Yuan had his banners and drums, and Li Shimin had the judgement of the single instant when he broke out.
kits: 卡面這副科林斯青銅盔是希臘青銅時代重步兵的頭部防具：整體錘打成形，頭頂留冠脊以插羽飾，顏面覆以連續的鼻梁與護頰，只在正面斜開兩道眼縫，份量連內襯以數公斤計，戴上之後聽覺與視野都大幅受限，所以它只配給站在方陣裡、靠鄰舍傳遞命令的步兵，一旦要騎射、要追擊、要回頭觀察就立刻變成累贅；科林斯自己的瓶畫上，這種頭盔幾乎總是畫在正面列陣、行進的隊形裡。與之相對，隋軍的裝備體系完全是另一路數：頭戴兜鍪或冑，配皮甲、布甲，少數精騎另有鎧，長兵器用馬槊與槊，弓以角弓為主，弩有大架弩與擘張弩，近身靠短刀與長槍，攻城則備櫓、拒馬、雲梯與投石一類器械。甄翟兒一方的裝備則近乎拼湊：獵具與農具改成的叉、鍬、梃及繩索，零散撿來的隋軍皮甲，少量繳獲的弓弩，幾乎沒有成建制的馬匹輸送。希臘的頭盔守的是編制，義軍守的只是人多。
kitsEn: The Corinthian helmet on the card is the head protection of Greek heavy infantry in the Bronze Age. It was beaten as a single piece, kept a crest ridge on the crown for a feather plume, and covered the face with a continuous nasal and cheek guard, leaving only two eye slits cut at an angle on the front. Its weight, counting the lining, runs into several kilogrammes, and once it is on, hearing and vision are badly degraded. It therefore belongs to men who stand in a phalanx and take orders from their neighbour, and it turns at once into dead weight the moment a man must shoot, must pursue, or must look back. On Corinthian pottery the helmet is almost always painted in frontal marching order. The Sui system is the other way entirely: leather and cloth armour with doumou or zhou headgear, armour for the elite cavalry, long weapons such as the ma shuo and the shuo, bows of horn, crossbows of the large-frame and the b-zhang types, short swords and long spears at close quarters, and for sieges the lu, the cheval de frise, ladders and stone-throwers. Zhen Di'er's men had almost nothing in common: hunting gear and farm tools converted into forks, hoes, clubs and ropes, a few Sui leather coats picked up here and there, a scatter of captured bows and crossbows, and no organised horse transport at all. Greek helmets guarded a formation; the insurgents had only crowds.
tactics: 雀鼠谷在太原西南的歷山一帶，谷道兩壁迫近、出口收窄，天然不利於人數壓倒的一方。甄翟兒的戰法非常簡單：十萬眾不列陣，只作環形疊層包圍，把李淵數千官軍團在中間，前排擠、後排推，企圖以體力與人數耗死對手，即史書所說的圍淵數匝。這種打法缺乏器械、缺乏統一指揮，靠的是擠壓而非攻堅，一旦被點破就整片鬆散。李淵的部署把虎賁精騎置於前列、步兵結陣殿後，步兵未至即被敵反圍，陣形被拉成幾個孤立的團。轉折在李世民：他率精兵自亂陣中強行突出，斜插敵陣深處，把李淵從數重包圍中拔出，如史書所記拔淵於萬眾之中；其後步兵趕到會合，兩面合擊，義軍才真正崩潰。整套打法可以拆成兩步：騎兵用速度撕開包圍，步兵用陣線完成殲滅。科林斯青銅盔正是這套邏輯的反面寫照——它為站在陣列裡的人而造，在谷中橫衝直撞時毫無用處，只有在平原上列成密集方陣時才成立。隋廷這邊另有結構性劣勢：十二道使者分頭追剿而無統一指揮，兵少且散，虞世基又壓下各地告急的奏報，援兵自然來不了。
tacticsEn: Sparrow Valley lies in the Lishan district southwest of Taiyuan. The valley road is hemmed in by its two walls and narrows toward its exits, which is badly suited to the side that simply has more men. Zhen Di'er's method was plain. His hundred thousand were not arrayed but piled in rings around Li Yuan's few thousand, pushing from behind and pressing from the front, hoping to grind the Sui force down by weight and numbers alone, in the words of the record, surrounding Li Yuan several times over. Lacking siege gear and unified command, the pressure was a kind of shoving rather than an assault, and once it was pierced the whole mass came apart. Li Yuan's deployment put the Tiger Guard horse in front and the infantry in a column behind; the foot had not yet arrived when the enemy closed around them, and the line was torn into several isolated clusters. The turn came with Li Shimin: he led picked troops in a hard breakout from the confused line, drove deep into the enemy and pulled Li Yuan out of the multiple rings of encirclement, exactly as the record says, snatching him out from amid tens of thousands. When the infantry closed up and joined him, the two sides struck together and the insurgents broke. The whole method divides into two steps: cavalry uses speed to tear open the ring, infantry uses the line to finish the work. The Corinthian helmet is the exact inverse of that logic, made for men who stand in ranks; in the valley it was useless, and only in a dense phalanx on open ground did it make sense. The court's structural weakness compounded this: the twelve circuit envoys hunted separately without unified command, the troops were few and scattered, and Yu Shiji held back the urgent petitions, so no relief could come.
data: 史書留下的數字都取自《資治通鑑》同一段記載：甄翟兒眾十萬，李淵眾才數千，賊圍淵數匝，步兵至，合擊，大破之。官軍與義軍的兵力比在十比一以上，但十萬與數千都是概數，義軍真正投入合圍的當然遠少於全軍，否則十萬人擠不進一條谷道。同一卷裡可作對照的數字還有：正月朝集使不至者二十餘郡，朝廷因此議遣使者十二道討捕盜賊；四月歷山飛部將甄翟兒眾十萬寇太原，將軍潘長文敗死；八月趙萬海眾數十萬自恆山寇高陽；十二月林士弘部眾至十餘萬；稍後河間格謙擁眾十餘萬據豆子自稱燕王。文中沒有交戰雙方死傷的確數，也沒有糧秣消耗的記載，可推知的是：數千官軍出城必須自太原倉儲取糧，義軍只能就地徵集，這才是義軍速戰速決、官軍必須速勝的真正原因。科林斯青銅盔沒有留下官方重量與價錢，只在科林斯陶瓶的畫面裡被記下外觀：冠脊、斜開的雙眼縫，以及半張被遮住的臉。
dataEn: Every figure comes from a single passage of the Comprehensive Mirror: Zhen Di'er had a hundred thousand men, Li Yuan had only a few thousand, the enemy surrounded him several times over, the infantry arrived, the two sides struck together, and the insurgents were routed. The odds were better than ten to one against the Sui, but both numbers are approximations, and the rebels who actually closed the ring must have been far fewer than their whole host, since a hundred thousand men cannot be pressed into one valley road. Figures from the same volume provide the comparison. In the first month the envoys gathering at court had not arrived from more than twenty commanderies, which is why the court resolved to send envoys along twelve circuits against the bandits; in the fourth month Li Shanfei's subordinate Zhen Di'er brought a hundred thousand men down from Lishan and the Sui general Pan Changwen was killed; in the eighth month Zhao Wanhai led several tens of thousands from Hengshan against Gaoyang; in the twelfth month Lin Shihong's following numbered more than a hundred thousand; and soon after Ge Qian of Hejian held more than a hundred thousand at Douzi and called himself Prince of Yan. The text gives no casualty count for either side and no figure for grain consumption, but the logic can be reconstructed: a few thousand government troops had to draw rations from the Taiyuan granaries before marching out, while the insurgents could only take what they seized, and that is why the rebels had to fight fast and the Sui had to win fast. The Corinthian helmet left no official weight or price, only its appearance in Corinthian vase painting: the crest, the two angled eye slits and a half-covered face.
cause: 起因是一條由北向南崩解的鏈條。隋煬帝三征高句麗，兵役與徭役抽空了丁口，江淮郡縣為求進獻競相刻剝，饑荒逼得百姓採樹皮、搗稿為末，盜賊遂遍於海內。正月朝集使不至者二十餘郡，朝廷才議定遣使者十二道分頭討捕盜賊；四月歷山飛部將甄翟兒率眾十萬自歷山殺向太原，隋將潘長文敗死，太原告急。朝廷無暇從容調兵，只能派唐公李淵以右驍衛將軍出鎮太原討賊——李淵既是隋室姻親又是宿將，本就是被猜忌的一類人，這道任命既是倚重也是發配。科林斯青銅盔可以提供另一個視角：希臘城邦之所以能維持戰力，靠的是全民皆兵的編制與一致的裝備，裝備統一就是城邦認同；隋末的局勢恰好相反，義軍裝備雜亂、忠誠更雜亂，於是規模再大也成不了軍。雀鼠谷一役正是這樣的對照：幾千官軍憑編制、旗號與騎兵，能打崩十萬散兵，靠的從來不是人數。
causeEn: The cause was a chain breaking from north to south. Yang Guang's three campaigns against Goguryeo drained the country of able-bodied men; the commanderies of Jianghuai ground the people down in a competition to offer tribute; famine drove people to strip bark and pound grain husks, and bandits spread across the empire. In the first month, when more than twenty commanderies failed to send their envoys to court, the court resolved on twelve circuit envoys to hunt the bandits down. In the fourth month Zhen Di'er brought a hundred thousand men down from Lishan toward Taiyuan and the Sui general Pan Changwen was killed, and the city was in danger. There was no time to move troops in orderly fashion, so the court sent the Duke of Tang, Li Yuan, out as Right Xiaowei General to fight: a man bound to the Sui house by marriage and also a veteran of the older guard, such an appointment was at once an appeal to him and a removal. The Corinthian helmet offers a second reading. Greek city-states kept their fighting strength because every citizen trained and because the equipment was uniform, and uniform equipment was the badge of citizenship. Late Sui China was the exact opposite: the insurgents' gear was a jumble and their loyalty a greater jumble, so no matter how large the crowd it never became an army. Sparrow Valley is that contrast in miniature. A few thousand government soldiers broke a hundred thousand of the rabble through organisation, banners and cavalry, never through numbers.
impact: 最直接的後果是太原得解，隋廷在北方的最後一個像樣的軍事支點暫時穩住，李淵也藉此在晉陽集結兵馬、收攏亡命、操練騎兵，一年後的太原起兵才有底子。李世民第一次上陣即傳名於史，拔淵於萬眾之中一句，此後數年被反覆引用，成為他一身武勇的標誌之一。往北看，河北才是真正的深淵：張金稱、高士達相繼覆滅，竇建德乘勢收編各部，勝兵至十餘萬；河間格謙自稱燕王，江都的王世充奉命討之；淮南李子通、杜伏威，豫章林士弘已建號稱帝，隋室在江南與河北的號令只剩下紙面。唯一沒變的是情報的失效：虞世基把各地告敗的表狀一律減損，煬帝至死都不知道盜賊已遍海內。科林斯青銅盔那句看得見的代價是戴它的人只能靠隊形活，說的正是這件事——隋末不是死於一場大敗，而是死於編制先崩、隊形先散。
impactEn: The most direct effect was that Taiyuan was relieved, the last coherent military pillar the Sui still held in the north held together a while longer, and Li Yuan used the interval to gather men, absorb fugitives and drill cavalry at Jinyang, the stock of strength on which the Taiyuan rising of the following year was built. Li Shimin's first appearance in the field made his name at once, and the phrase about snatching his father out from amid tens of thousands was quoted again and again in later years as a mark of his martial reputation. Further north lay the real abyss: Zhang Jincheng and Gao Shida were destroyed one after another, Ding Jiande gathered up the broken bands and grew to more than a hundred thousand fighting men; Ge Qian at Hejian called himself Prince of Yan and Wang Shichong was sent from Jiangdu to deal with him; Li Zitong and Du Fuwei held the south of the Huai, and Lin Shihong had already founded a state in Yuzhang. The one thing that did not change was the failure of information: Yu Shiji trimmed down the reports of defeat from every commandery, and the emperor died without knowing that bandits filled the empire. The line on the Corinthian helmet, that the visible price is that the man who wears it can only live by his formation, says exactly this. The Sui did not die from one great defeat but from the first dissolution of its organisation and of its formations.
result: 雀鼠谷一役的直接結果是隋軍大破甄翟兒之眾，太原之圍解，歷山飛部的勢力被打斷，隋軍在河東重新站住腳；但它改變不了全局。甄翟兒的殘部並未消滅，其眾或散入河北各路義軍，或與同時並起的魏刀兒、竇建德等部合流，隋朝在河北實際上只剩幾座孤城。往後一年，隋廷的北方樞紐連環崩塌：劉武周起兵雁門、進逼太原，晉陽城破時王威與高君雅戰死，李淵父子隨之舉兵，隋室最後一點餘溫就此熄滅；再往後是瓦崗、洛口與江都的一連串結局。收束在這場戰役本身的話，李淵贏下的不是一座谷地，而是一支敢於帶數十騎鑽進十萬人之中的隊伍，以及一年後能扛起一個新王朝的幹才。科林斯青銅盔則留在科林斯的陶瓶與墓葬裡，提醒後人：真正的護具從來不只是一副頭盔，而是一整套站得住的隊形。
resultEn: The direct outcome of Sparrow Valley was that the Sui army routed Zhen Di'er's host, the siege of Taiyuan was lifted, Li Shanfei's rising was broken, and the Sui army regained its footing in Hedong. It did not change the larger situation. Zhen Di'er's remnants were not destroyed: some of his men scattered into the other rebel bands of the north, some merged with the rising forces of Wei Dao'er and Ding Jiande, and the Sui retained in fact only a few isolated cities in the north. Over the next year the northern pivot of the court collapsed in turn: Liu Wuzhou rose in Yanmen and pressed on Taiyuan, and when Jinyang fell, Wang Wei and Gao Junya died fighting, after which Li Yuan and his sons raised troops and the last warmth of the Sui went out; what followed was the succession of Wagang, Luokou and Jiangdu. Stated in terms of the battle itself, Li Yuan did not win a valley. He won a body of men willing to cut into a hundred thousand with a few dozen riders, and the officers who, a year later, could carry a new dynasty. The Corinthian helmet stayed where it was, in Corinthian vases and graves, reminding later generations that real protection was never one helmet but a whole formation that could hold its shape.
